infobox.usage: Unlocks dorm room 214 in the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Dorm room 214 key (Dorm 214) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the three-story dormitory with a tag reading "214" on it.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - The key can be found between pallets in a garage with the number 88 on the eastern side of Customs.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Located on the second floor of the three-story dorms on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- One Safe
- Loose loot (Ammunition)
- Possible Dorm room 203 key in the red mug
